page.title: Board
page.purpose: Answer 'what needs my attention' before anything else — fired triggers, offers earning nothing, and the operator's financial posture. This is the monetization team's single address, so it must be readable cold, without first knowing which offers exist, and it must serve the financial member as well as the catalog ones.

priorities.statement: Which triggers fired since I last looked — these are decisions waiting on me
Which active offers have earned nothing — the most expensive kind of stale
Which sources could not be read, and how old the last good reading is
Where the operator stands financially — runway, goal verdicts, and the default-alive gap — as standing context beneath the decisions above
Everything else, ranked below the four above

states.description: The surface at rest with data present — the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
Nothing in flight; the surface is at rest and its controls are usable.
A user-triggered operation is in flight and its outcome is not yet known.
An operation completed; the result is announced, not merely rendered.
First read of the surface's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
A write is in flight; the affected control is disabled and says why.
A background read is refreshing data the user is already looking at.
A user-requested re-read of data already on screen.
The query succeeded and there is genuinely nothing — distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing source could not be read; what is missing is named.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated.
An automatic retry is in progress; attempt count and next attempt are visible.
The caller's role does not permit this; what role would is stated.
The client cannot reach the API; queued or read-only behavior is explained.
One ranking source is unreadable; it is named with its last-good age while the others continue to rank. Never rendered as an empty board.
The Money Ledger actuals join could not be read. Earnings are reported as unknown with a reason; no offer is shown as having earned zero.
Every board source contributed. The only state in which the ranking is complete.
The Money Ledger posture read succeeded. Runway, each goal verdict with its sustain-window progress, and the default-alive gap are shown with their source and age.

The posture read could not be completed. Runway and the goal verdicts are reported as unknown with a reason and a last-good age. Never a zero runway and never an unmet verdict — an unreadable ledger and an exhausted one are opposite conclusions.
Money Ledger returned a position it had already marked partial. The board propagates that qualification rather than flattening it, and names the adapter the ledger said was missing.

elements.name: Fired triggers
elements.description: Triggers that have fired since the last visit — decisions waiting on the operator.

elements.name: Active and earning nothing
elements.description: Active offers with no matching money events. The most expensive kind of silence.

elements.name: Sources
elements.description: Per-source contribution status for this ranking, each degrading independently.
States that the actuals join could not be read, with a reason and the age of the last good reading.

elements.name: Board
elements.description: The ranked entries, computed at read time across every available source.
Explains an empty board — nothing fired and nothing is silent — distinct from sources being unreadable.

elements.name: Financial posture
elements.description: Runway and the default-alive gap, read from Money Ledger. Present because this board is the team's one address and its financial member is served here rather than at a second surface.

elements.name: Goal verdicts
elements.description: Each declared goal's verdict with its sustain-window progress. A verdict without the window would report met on a first good reading.
The source and age of the posture figures, and — where the ledger reported the position as partial — which adapter it said was missing.
States that the posture read could not be completed, with a reason and the age of the last good reading. Shown in place of the figures, never alongside a substituted zero.

claims.statement: When the actuals join cannot be read, the board states that earnings are unknown with a reason, and no offer is shown as having earned zero.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-002 verbatim. An unavailable ledger rendered as zero is indistinguishable from an offer that genuinely earned nothing — and the two lead to opposite decisions.

claims.statement: Each board source reports its own availability, and healthy sources continue to rank while one is unavailable.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-003. A board that blanks entirely when one source fails is less useful than the several surfaces it replaced.

claims.statement: Fired triggers read before active-but-earning-nothing entries and before the rest of the ranking.
claims.rationale: Priorities 1 and 2. A fired trigger is a decision waiting on the operator; everything else is context. Direction-aware so the order survives RTL.

claims.statement: A ranking computed with a degraded source is perceivably different from one computed with every source available.
claims.rationale: Otherwise a partial ranking is read as a complete one, which is the board-level form of the silent-zero failure.

claims.statement: A board with genuinely nothing to report is perceivably different from one whose sources could not be read.
claims.rationale: 'Nothing needs you' and 'I could not tell whether anything needs you' are opposite conclusions that both render as an empty list.

claims.statement: Fired triggers and any source degradation are visible without scrolling at every viewport.
claims.rationale: This is a surface read a few times a week and understood cold. What needs action, and whether the picture is complete, must arrive together.

claims.statement: When the posture read fails, the board states that runway and the goal verdicts are unknown with a reason, and shows no runway figure and no verdict.
claims.rationale: INT-005, and the actuals rule applied to the second read. A zero runway is the most alarming possible wrong number, and an unmet verdict on an unreadable ledger would send the operator to fix a business problem that may not exist.

claims.statement: A position Money Ledger marked partial arrives here still marked partial, naming the adapter the ledger said was missing.
claims.rationale: INT-005. This board is the surface the operator actually reads, so a caveat the ledger attached and this board drops is a caveat that never existed. The one-hop distance is exactly where that loss would happen unnoticed.

claims.statement: Runway and the goal verdicts are accompanied by their source and the age of the reading.
claims.rationale: These figures are computed elsewhere and rendered here. Without a named source and an age they read as this scenario's own numbers, which is the first step toward someone caching them.

claims.statement: Each goal verdict is accompanied by its progress through the sustain window, not only whether the threshold is currently crossed.
claims.rationale: The default-alive rule requires three consecutive months. A verdict that ignores the window reports met on the first good month and is wrong; this claim is stated identically on the Money Ledger side so the guarantee survives the hop.

claims.statement: A board whose posture read failed is perceivably different from one showing real figures.
claims.rationale: The board-level form of the silent-zero failure, on the read whose figures carry the most consequence.

claims.statement: Fired triggers read before the financial posture summary.
claims.rationale: Priority 1 is unchanged by the posture rows. A fired trigger is a decision waiting on the operator; posture is standing context that changes slowly. Direction-aware so the order survives RTL.
